title: dnp3: add filters for point indices based on the object type
description:
Currently the DNP3 dissector uses one field (dnp3.al.index) to hold the point index, shared amongst all object types.
The index "space" is not actually shared between the object types, e.g. the binary input index space is logically different from the analog input index space.
This patch implements header fields for dnp3.al.{bi,dbi,counter,ai,ao,os}.index,
as well as .event and .static versions of the same, and .cmnd indices for output objects.

Fix #17441
